title: Comparison of in-solution and SP3 sample processing workflows on HeLa cell samples
projectDescription: Comparison of in-solution and single-pot, solid-phase-enchanced sample preparation (SP3) sample processing workflows on HeLa cell samples, using different lysis buffers based on SDS and guanidine hydrochloride, for optimal analysis by liquid chromatography mass spectrometry (LC-MS)
sampleProcessingProtocol: Standard in-solution with guanidine hydrochloride lysis buffer and  solid-phase-enchanced sample preparation (SP3) sample with guanidine hydrochloride and SDS lysis buffer processing workflows on HeLa cell samples. Samples are desalted and then analyzed unfractionated and after fractionation with high-pH reversed chromatography on an Eclipse Tribrid mass spectrometer.
dataProcessingProtocol: Samples were run individually with Proteome Discoverer software according to DDA and label-free workflows. Output reports were further analysed in Excel. Results were displayed in bar plots.
